body:
`.adlc/` means both "this repo opted into ADLC" and "scratch space for user-scoped plugin state". Three code paths created the second kind in $HOME (adlc-cursor session state, the codex/copilot flail hooks, the cursor scaffolder) and two read any ancestor `.adlc/` as the first kind (the claude-code root walk, herdr's repoRootFromCwd), so a directory in $HOME captured every project beneath it.

Creators: cursor state moves to ~/.cursor/adlc (host namespace, matching @adlc/gemini); the flail default path is used only inside a real ADLC repo; the scaffolder refuses $HOME.

Consumers: the root marker is a ticket store rather than a bare directory; the walk never adopts $HOME by ascending; and the ancestor fallback never reaches outside the enclosing git repo.
title: Stop ADLC creating or trusting ~/.adlc
